Magnitude 7.0 Earthquake Strikes Tibet, Killing 16

A 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Tibet, resulting in at least 16 deaths and 46 injuries. State media reported that over 300 houses collapsed, leaving hundreds homeless. The earthquake occurred within a span of approximately 40 minutes. Rescue teams are battling devastation in the region. China's Xi Jinping has ordered urgent relief efforts.
